dogecoin.text: @DogecoinMemes @dogecoin I just got scammed for 91k dogecoins. Scam was too elaborate for my dumbass. Telling me my peers need to be fixed cause I was on an old fork with my 2013 wallet. Trying to shed more light on how these scammers operate. Link to my Reddit post below
